# git-a2a schema 2

The only domain commands are `init`, `add`, `pull`, `remove`, and `list`. One dependency alias
records its Git source, requested ref, exact applied commit, and saved adapter variants. Every
polyglot binding and the optional surface use that commit. `list` is offline and read-only.

An upstream used as a dependency must declare one `agent.card`. The Agent Card remains the source
of interfaces, skills, and authentication. git-a2a never sends a message, runs or hosts an agent,
or manages tasks. An external A2A client performs communication.

`add` installs or resolves code using applicable adapters. `pull` updates every dependency;
`pull NAME` updates one. Both use native manager operations, including restoration of missing
installed state. Pull resolves the declared ref again rather than replaying the old lock.
`remove` reconciles native declarations, locks, and installed state while preserving other
dependencies. Git submodule is an ordinary adapter and an explicit initial-selection fallback
for unsupported native sources; missing tools do not trigger a manager switch.

An HTTPS Agent Card remains a URL. A repository-relative card is copied byte-for-byte from the
applied commit to `.git-a2a/agents/NAME/` and exposed by `list` as a usable local reference.
Read the optional published surface, consult the responsible agent using an external A2A client,
then consume its published changes with `pull NAME`.

Canonical sources:
- https://git-a2a.com/
- https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a/blob/main/spec/README.md
- https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a/blob/main/docs/cli.md
- https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a/blob/main/docs/manifest-reference.md
